handoffStates.afterSupportEvidence: next required course lesson remains primary CTA

stateRules: Tutor cards inside IELPS core app should hand off through configurable frontend URL.
Booking requires authenticated learner or parent.
Payment or entitlement must pass before confirmed booking.
Live room token must only be issued for confirmed booking participants.
Tutor cannot enter learner progress as course completion.
Tutor session can create support evidence, notes, and recommendations.
Learner always returns to the A1-C2 course spine after session.
